package.description: Dygma wireless keyboard battery status (Defy, Raise 2, Sonsei).

en-US.description: Dygma wireless keyboard battery status (Defy, Raise 2, Sonsei).
en-US.longDescription:
System-tray app showing the battery level of a Dygma wireless keyboard
(Defy, Raise 2, Sonsei), with low-battery notifications. Installs two
portable commands: dygmate (CLI battery readout) and dygmate-tray (tray app).
en-US.name: dygmate
